title: Worker assignOrg stage: match or auto-create Aspiration+Project
description:
Wire the auto-org flow into the worker pipeline: after a Post is written for an UNSCOPED session-auth submission, embed its classification signal, reverse-look-up, and either assign an existing Project or auto-create Aspiration+Project. Part of epic ao-gpx.

DEPENDENCIES: ClassificationPrep+adapters (ao-v8f), reverse-lookup (ao-q1e). Also uses embedding client (ao-8fy) and projects helpers.

NEW FILE: apps/worker/src/pipeline/classification/assign-org.ts
- export async function assignOrg(args: { input: PipelineInput; parsed: GeminiOutput; postId: string; classificationInput: { prep; parts } }): Promise<{ projectId: string; created: boolean } | null>
  GUARD: return null unless input.projectId == null AND input.submittedById != null AND CLASSIFY_ENABLED.
  STEPS:
  1. embedding = await embedContent(classificationInput.parts, { dimensionality }).
  2. { categories, bestProject } = await classifyContent({ ownerId: submittedById, contentEmbedding: embedding, projectMatchMin, categoryMatchMin }).
  3. If bestProject: assignPostToProject(ownerId, postId, bestProject.projectId); also backfill IngestSubmission.projectId for the submission(s) (new helper in packages/db/src/ingest.ts, e.g. setSubmissionProject — ingest.ts owns submission writes). Return { projectId, created:false }.
  4. Else AUTO-CREATE: derive a Project title + description from prep.retrievalText + top categories. Keep it cheap/deterministic: title = Title-Cased best candidateCategory or top category name; description = one sentence referencing top categories + domain. (Optionally a tiny Gemini call to name it — but default to deterministic to avoid latency/cost.) Then:
     - createAspiration({ ownerId, title: <broad domain/top-category>, description }) — Aspiration = scope.
     - createProject({ ownerId, title, description, aspirationId }) — Project under it.
     - assignPostToProject + backfill submission projectId.
     - upsertProjectEmbedding({ projectId, ownerId, retrievalText: prep.retrievalText, embedding, embeddingHash, modelVersion, dimensionality }) so future content can match this new project.
     Return { projectId, created:true }.

INTEGRATION POINT: apps/worker/src/index.ts / apps/worker/src/pipeline/pipeline.ts. The pipeline currently runs runGemini then writePost, then the worker marks submissions completed and deletes staged files. Insert classification-input building + assignOrg AFTER writePost (postId known) but BEFORE staged-file deletion (image/av adapters need the bytes). Make assignOrg failures NON-FATAL: log and continue (the post still exists, just unassigned) so classification never dead-letters an otherwise-successful ingest.

ACCEPTANCE: submitting an unscoped session-auth url/note/image yields a Post with projectId set (matched or created), and IngestSubmission.projectId backfilled. Bearer ingest unaffected. assignOrg errors are swallowed (logged) and don't fail the job. bun check-types + bun lint pass.
close_reason: assign-org.ts assignOrg: guards unscoped+user-attributed+enabled; embeds classificationInput.parts; classifyContent; matches existing project (assignPostToProject + setSubmissionProject) or auto-creates Aspiration+Project, assigns, seeds ProjectEmbedding with the content vector. Wired into pipeline.ts after writePost (before staged-file delete), non-fatal. queryPrefix used for both content and project vectors for comparability.

title: Schema: CategoryEmbedding.purpose + ProjectEmbedding + DB helpers
description:
Extend the Prisma schema and add DB access helpers for embeddings. Part of epic ao-gpx.

DEPENDENCY: env/docs bead (for modelVersion/dimensionality conventions).

SCHEMA (packages/db/prisma/schema.prisma):
1. CategoryEmbedding: add `purpose String` (why this analysis category exists for classification — distinct from `description`, which is what belongs here). Keep existing path/name/fullPath/parentPath/depth/fileCount/description/embedding/embeddingHash/modelVersion/dimensionality.
2. New model ProjectEmbedding:
   model ProjectEmbedding {
     id             String   @id @default(cuid())
     projectId      String   @unique
     project        Project  @relation("ProjectEmbedding", fields: [projectId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
     ownerId        String   // denormalized for owner-scoped lookup without a join
     retrievalText  String   // the text that was embedded (for re-embed/debug)
     embedding      Float[]
     embeddingHash  String
     modelVersion   String   // e.g. "gemini-embedding-2"
     dimensionality Int      // e.g. 768
     createdAt      DateTime @default(now())
     updatedAt      DateTime @updatedAt
     @@index([ownerId])
     @@index([embeddingHash])
   }
   Add back-relation on Project: `embedding ProjectEmbedding? @relation("ProjectEmbedding")`.
3. Re-export the ProjectEmbedding row type by name from packages/db/src/index.ts (the repo re-exports model types individually, NOT `export *`, to avoid Turbopack warnings).

MIGRATION: run inside packages/db via `bunx prisma migrate dev --name add_embeddings_purpose_project` (turbo/bun mangle --name; invoke prisma directly in the package). Then `bun run db:generate`.

DB HELPERS — new file packages/db/src/embeddings.ts (export from src/index.ts):
- upsertProjectEmbedding({ projectId, ownerId, retrievalText, embedding, embeddingHash, modelVersion, dimensionality })
- listProjectEmbeddings(ownerId): ProjectEmbedding[]  (owner-scoped, for in-memory cosine in v1)
- listCategoryEmbeddings(): CategoryEmbedding[]        (global taxonomy)
- upsertCategoryEmbedding(node)                        (used by the seed script)
Keep these query/write helpers OUT of posts.ts (posts.ts is query-only by repo contract).

ACCEPTANCE: db:generate succeeds, types resolve, bun check-types + bun lint pass. Migration applies cleanly on a fresh DB.
close_reason: Added CategoryEmbedding.purpose + ProjectEmbedding model + Project back-relation; migration add_embeddings_purpose_project applied; packages/db/src/embeddings.ts helpers (upsert/list category+project, listProjectsNeedingEmbedding); type re-exports. db:generate + tsc clean.

title: Embedding client: @google/genai gemini-embedding-2
description:
Add the Gemini Embedding 2 client used by all classification work. Part of epic ao-gpx.

DEPENDENCY: needs env/docs bead (EMBEDDING_MODEL/EMBEDDING_DIMENSIONALITY).

PACKAGE: add "@google/genai" to apps/worker/package.json dependencies (latest). Do NOT use @google/generative-ai (deprecated) or @ai-sdk/google for embeddings. Generation code keeps using @ai-sdk/google.

NEW FILE: apps/worker/src/lib/embeddings.ts
- import { GoogleGenAI } from "@google/genai"
- Reuse API key resolution from apps/worker/src/lib/ai-config.ts (resolveApiKey/requireApiKey: GEMINI_API_KEY || GOOGLE_API_KEY || GOOGLE_GENAI_API_KEY). Construct new GoogleGenAI({ apiKey }).
- export type EmbedPart = { text: string } | { inlineData: { mimeType: string; data: string } } (data = base64).
- export async function embedContent(parts: EmbedPart[], opts?: { dimensionality?: number }): Promise<number[]>
    const res = await ai.models.embedContent({ model: getEmbeddingModel(), contents: [{ parts }], config: { outputDimensionality: dim } });
    return res.embeddings[0].values;  // single aggregated vector
- Embedding 2 has NO taskType param: task is a TEXT PREFIX in the content. Provide helpers:
    queryPrefix(text) => `task: search result | query: ${text}`        (asymmetric content/query side)
    documentText(name, text) => `title: ${name} | text: ${text}`        (asymmetric indexed-doc side)
    classifyText(text) => `task: classification | query: ${text}`       (symmetric project<->content match)
- export function cosineSimilarity(a: number[], b: number[]): number   (guard equal length; return dot/(|a||b|), 0 if either zero-norm). Embedding 2 auto-normalizes truncated dims, so raw cosine is fine.
- export function embeddingHash(text: string): string  (stable hash of the prefixed input, e.g. sha256 hex; used for the embeddingHash column to skip re-embedding unchanged inputs).
- Limits to respect (gemini-embedding-2): max 8192 input tokens; images max 6 per request (PNG/JPEG/webp/bmp/heic/heif/avif); audio <=180s (mp3/wav); video <=120s (mp4/mpeg, 32 frames sampled, no audio track); PDF 1 file <=6 pages. Truncate/limit inputs accordingly.

CONFIG: extend apps/worker/src/lib/ai-config.ts — DEFAULT_EMBEDDING_MODEL => "gemini-embedding-2"; add getEmbeddingModel() and getEmbeddingDimensionality() (env EMBEDDING_DIMENSIONALITY, default 768). Keep embeddingModel in AIConfig.

ACCEPTANCE: bun check-types + bun lint pass. A tiny inline smoke (covered by the smoke bead) can embed two strings and print cosine.
close_reason: Added @google/genai@2.8.0; apps/worker/src/lib/embeddings.ts with embedContent, task-prefix helpers, cosineSimilarity, embeddingHash; ai-config getEmbeddingModel/getEmbeddingDimensionality, default gemini-embedding-2. check-types + lint clean.

title: Epic: Auto-Org + Analysis Categories via Gemini Embedding 2
description:
EPIC. When a session-auth ingest arrives with no projectId selected ("None" in the web/mobile composer), the worker should automatically file the resulting Post under a Project (Focus Area), either by matching an existing Project or by auto-creating an Aspiration + Project. Classification is powered by a domain-agnostic Analysis Category taxonomy and Gemini Embedding 2 multimodal embeddings.

DOMAIN MODEL (already exists in packages/db/prisma/schema.prisma):
- Aspiration = top-level user goal ("scope"). Owns Projects.
- Project = a concrete Focus Area; a Post is filed under at most one Project.
- Post.projectId and IngestSubmission.projectId are nullable (onDelete: SetNull).
- CategoryEmbedding / TagEmbedding tables exist but are UNUSED (no population/search code).

TRIGGER CONDITION: org auto-assignment runs ONLY when projectId === null AND submittedById !== null. Bearer-token ingest (/api/ingest, /api/ingest-images, /api/ingest-file) has no user context and must remain unaffected.

KEY CONSTRAINTS:
- Embeddings use @google/genai (model gemini-embedding-2), NOT the deprecated @google/generative-ai and NOT @ai-sdk/google (generation stays on @ai-sdk/google). See /Users/minasaleeb/.claude/skills/gemini-genai-js/SKILL.md.
- Staged binary files are deleted after writePost in apps/worker/src/index.ts, so any multimodal embedding of image/video/audio/pdf bytes MUST happen before cleanup.
- gemini-embedding-2 produces a SINGLE aggregated vector per request (text + media parts combined). Classify per submission, not per-URL.
- No test runner in this repo: verification = bun check-types + bun lint + smoke scripts + manual db:studio.

This epic tracks: bead init/docs, embedding client, schema, taxonomy seed, unified ClassificationPrep, reverse-lookup matcher, worker assignOrg stage, ProjectEmbedding upserts, smoke tests, composer hint. See child beads for granular work.
close_reason: Epic complete: all child beads closed. Auto-org via gemini-embedding-2 implemented end-to-end and verified by smoke scripts; full repo check-types 7/7 and lint 5/5 green.

title: Analysis Category ontology + seed script with embeddings
description:
Define a domain-agnostic Analysis Category taxonomy and a seed script that populates CategoryEmbedding with precomputed embeddings. Part of epic ao-gpx.

DEPENDENCIES: embedding client (ao-8fy) and schema/helpers (ao-7hw).

GOAL: categories must be GENERAL enough to match across users and content domains (NOT military-specific like apps/web/scripts/seed-military-taxonomy.ts). They form the reverse-lookup index that maps any captured material to a stable analysis facet, and that seed informs auto-created Project titles/descriptions.

ONTOLOGY (tree; path is slash-delimited, stored in CategoryEmbedding.path/fullPath/parentPath/depth). Each node has a `purpose` (why it exists for classification) and `description` (what belongs here). Minimum ~20 nodes across >=3 depth levels:
  analysis/                                   (root)
    subject-matter/                           what the content is about
      people-and-orgs, places, objects-and-artifacts, events, concepts-and-ideas, nature-and-science, media-and-culture
    artifact-type/                            what KIND of thing it is
      physical-object, image-or-photo, video, audio, document-or-text, web-resource, social-post
    intent/                                   WHY it was captured
      collect, research, reference, inspiration, publish, transact
    domain/                                   broad field
      history, technology, design, commerce, art, education, lifestyle, finance
    modality/                                 ingest modality (maps loosely to PostType)
      url-finding, note-blog, image-sight, social, av-media
(Adjust/extend as sensible; keep names lowercase kebab-case, generic, and reverse-lookup friendly.)

NEW FILE: apps/web/scripts/seed-analysis-categories.ts (model on seed-military-taxonomy.ts: slugify/titleCase helpers, idempotent upsert, run via `bun run apps/web/scripts/seed-analysis-categories.ts`). For EACH node:
- compute fullPath/parentPath/depth from the tree
- build the indexed-doc embedding input using documentText(name, `${purpose}. ${description}`) from embeddings.ts
- call embedContent([{ text }]) at EMBEDDING_DIMENSIONALITY
- upsertCategoryEmbedding({ path, name, fullPath, parentPath, depth, fileCount: 0, description, purpose, embedding, embeddingHash, modelVersion: "gemini-embedding-2", dimensionality })
- skip re-embedding when embeddingHash is unchanged (idempotent + cheap re-runs).

NOTE: the seed script runs in apps/web but needs the embedding client which lives in apps/worker. Either (a) move embeddings.ts to a shared spot importable by both, or (b) put the seed script in apps/worker/scripts. Prefer (b): apps/worker/scripts/seed-analysis-categories.ts, since the worker already owns embeddings + @ai-sdk. Document the chosen location.

ACCEPTANCE: running the seed populates >=20 CategoryEmbedding rows with non-empty embeddings and purpose; re-running is a no-op (idempotent). bun check-types + bun lint pass.
close_reason: 39-node domain-agnostic Analysis Category taxonomy (subject-matter/artifact-type/intent/domain/modality, depths 0-2) + apps/worker/scripts/seed-analysis-categories.ts. Seeded with gemini-embedding-2 @ 768 dims; idempotent (re-run skips all); all rows have purpose. Aligned local .env to gemini-embedding-2.

title: Smoke scripts: seed + classify + cosine
description:
End-to-end smoke verification for the auto-org pipeline. No Jest in this repo — these are runnable scripts with clear logging. Part of epic ao-gpx.

DEPENDENCIES: assignOrg (ao-77g), project-embedding backfill (ao-omo).

SCRIPTS (under apps/worker/scripts/, run with bun):
1. smoke-embeddings.ts: embed two related strings + one unrelated; print pairwise cosine; assert related pair > unrelated pair. Verifies @google/genai gemini-embedding-2 wiring + cosineSimilarity.
2. smoke-classify.ts: requires seeded categories (run seed-analysis-categories.ts first). Build ClassificationInput for (a) a text note fixture and (b) a small local image fixture; embed; classifyContent for a test ownerId; print ranked categories + bestProject; assert >=1 category above threshold.
3. Document a MANUAL end-to-end check in the script header / a short MD note: start worker, submit an unscoped session-auth ingest (composer "None" focus), then `bun run db:studio` and confirm Post.projectId set and IngestSubmission.projectId backfilled; confirm a new Aspiration+Project exist on first-of-its-kind content and reuse on similar content.

LOGGING: each script prints inputs, scores, and PASS/FAIL lines so a human (the user) can eyeball correctness. Per repo rule, do NOT claim tests pass — these are smoke aids for user-driven verification.

ACCEPTANCE: scripts run without throwing given GEMINI_API_KEY + DATABASE_URL; smoke-embeddings asserts the cosine ordering; bun check-types + bun lint pass.

title: ProjectEmbedding backfill on manual create/assign
description:
Ensure manually-created and manually-assigned Projects also get a ProjectEmbedding, so the reverse-lookup index covers ALL of a user's projects, not just auto-created ones. Part of epic ao-gpx.

DEPENDENCIES: schema/helpers (ao-7hw), embedding client (ao-8fy), assignOrg (ao-77g) for the upsert helper conventions.

PROBLEM: ao-77g only writes ProjectEmbedding when it auto-creates. Projects created via the web/mobile composer (POST /api/app/projects) or assigned manually (POST /api/app/posts/[slug]/project) would be invisible to classifyContent, so unscoped content could never match them.

OPTIONS (pick the simplest that keeps web free of the @google/genai dep):
A. WORKER-SIDE LAZY BACKFILL (preferred): in assign-org.ts classifyContent path, before matching, ensure the user's active Projects without a ProjectEmbedding get one. Build retrievalText from project.title + description (+ optionally a few of its existing posts' tags), embed with classifyText prefix, upsertProjectEmbedding. This keeps embedding work in the worker. Cache by embeddingHash to avoid recompute.
B. A standalone backfill script apps/worker/scripts/backfill-project-embeddings.ts that embeds all Projects lacking an embedding (run manually / on deploy).
Implement A (lazy, on-demand) AND B (bulk script) — A guarantees correctness at classify time; B lets you warm the index.

DETAIL for A: add listProjectsNeedingEmbedding(ownerId) to packages/db (active projects whose id not in ProjectEmbedding). embed + upsert each. Keep it bounded (a user has few projects).

ACCEPTANCE: after a manual project exists, an unscoped ingest can match it (ProjectEmbedding present). Bulk script populates embeddings for all projects. bun check-types + bun lint pass.
close_reason: Lazy backfill ensureProjectEmbeddings(ownerId) in assign-org embeds active projects lacking an embedding before matching (queryPrefix, listProjectsNeedingEmbedding). Bulk script apps/worker/scripts/backfill-project-embeddings.ts warms the index post-deploy. check-types+lint clean.

title: Unified ClassificationPrep + per-material adapters
description:
Create a shared ClassificationPrep schema and per-material adapters that turn any pipeline output into a uniform classification signal (+ optional media parts for multimodal embedding). Part of epic ao-gpx.

DEPENDENCY: embedding client (ao-8fy) for the EmbedPart type.

BACKGROUND: Instagram already has a rich ClassificationPrepSchema in apps/worker/src/pipeline/instagram/digest.ts (candidateCategories, distinguishingFeatures, negativeEvidence, keywords, uncertaintyNotes, retrievalText). Lift the shape into a shared module and reuse it for every material kind.

NEW DIR: apps/worker/src/pipeline/classification/
- prep.ts: export the shared ClassificationPrep zod schema + type. Fields: candidateCategories (1-8 kebab-case), distinguishingFeatures, keywords, retrievalText (dense 60-180 word paragraph, the primary embed text), domain (short), confidenceNotes. Keep flat for embedding.
- adapters.ts: export buildClassificationInput(input: PipelineInput, parsed: GeminiOutput, extra?): { prep: ClassificationPrep; parts: EmbedPart[] }.

PER-MATERIAL adapters (PipelineInput union is in apps/worker/src/pipeline/types.ts; kinds: url | note | image | video | audio | document; plus IG/YT detected inside the url path):
- url (generic): retrievalText from the url_context summary + Gemini draft title/body. parts = [{ text: queryPrefix(retrievalText) }].
- note: retrievalText from note body + draft. text only.
- image batch (SIGHT): retrievalText from SightDraft (title/excerpt/imageAlts) + body. parts = up to 6 inline images (read staged bytes -> base64, correct mimeType) + a trailing { text: retrievalText }. Respect the 6-image cap.
- video/audio/document: retrievalText from the Gemini file-understanding summary (the generated post body). parts = inline staged file (respect limits: video <=120s mp4/mpeg, audio <=180s mp3/wav, pdf 1 file <=6 pages) + { text: retrievalText }. If the file violates a limit, fall back to text-only.
- Instagram: reuse digest.classificationPrep directly; parts = the post image (if available) + { text: retrievalText }.
- YouTube: condense entities + overview into retrievalText; TEXT ONLY (full transcript exceeds the 8192-token embed limit).

CRITICAL TIMING: adapters that read staged bytes must run BEFORE the worker deletes staged files (apps/worker/src/index.ts deletes after writePost). So buildClassificationInput must be called during/just after the pipeline while staged files still exist — coordinate with the assignOrg bead (ao-? worker stage).

ACCEPTANCE: a unit-ish smoke builds ClassificationInput for a note and an image fixture without throwing; bun check-types + bun lint pass. No behavior change to existing IG/YT post bodies.
close_reason: Shared ClassificationPrep schema (prep.ts: retrievalText/keywords/candidateCategories/domainHint + toPlainText/buildRetrievalText) and adapters.ts buildClassificationInput: derives prep from Gemini frontmatter (no extra LLM call), reuses IG digest retrievalText, embeds up to 6 inline staged images for SIGHT, text-only otherwise. check-types + lint clean.
